admission.justification: The staged-read and batch proofs prevent a first-paint fanout or a permanent first-gesture wait that leaves visible code unread.

applicability: Incremental marker and lane classification/text reads inside the review reading column.
conditions: A lane file in view starts without a gesture after the opening gate opens; files further down start when near view.
A card marker read also waits for the first page scroll, wheel, touch move, movement key outside editable fields, or selection.
The gate counts files: one lane file holds a slot until both classification and text requests settle, so eight files can mean16 requests.
Once near-view admission succeeds it is retained for that block. The current gate opening signal is cards no longer reading, not a join over every opening response.
exclusions: Deferring an already-visible lane file until a gesture.
Counting the two requests of one lane file as two files.
Claiming a wall-clock performance bound or full-browser1px stability from this request gate.
